detailPage.title: Application details
detailPage.application_status_tooltip: Set whether the application is active or inactive. When inactive, authentication requests are rejected.
detailPage.site_domain_tooltip: Enter the application site domain (e.g. example.com, myapp.co.kr).
detailPage.site_domain_invalid: Please enter a valid domain (e.g. example.com).
detailPage.test_url_authorize_tooltip: Opens the authorize page in a new tab using the current Callback URL.
detailPage.test_url_callback_tooltip: Opens the registered Callback URL in a new tab.
detailPage.test_url_fill_callback: Please enter a Callback URL first.
detailPage.callback_url_invalid: Please enter a valid URL (e.g. https://example.com/callback).
detailPage.callback_url_description: On successful authentication, BioPass sends an authorization code to this URL (your backend callback endpoint). Register a server URL, not a frontend page. Exchange the code on the server via POST /api/web/token.
detailPage.callback_param_state: state: The state value the client sent with the auth request is returned as-is (for CSRF and state validation).
detailPage.callback_param_code: code: A one-time authorization code returned only on success. The client exchanges this code via POST /api/web/token for an access token.
detailPage.callback_param_code_desc: One-time authorization code returned only on success. Used to exchange for an access token via POST /api/web/token.
detailPage.callback_param_state_desc: The state value the client sent with the auth request is returned as-is (for CSRF and state validation).
detailPage.callback_next_step: Next step: Extract the code from this URL and send POST /api/web/token with grant_type=authorization_code, code, client_id, and client_secret to exchange it for an access token.
detailPage.callback_failure_note: On authentication failure or error, the user is not redirected to this URL; an error page is shown by the server instead.
detailPage.auth_flow_params_intro: APIs and parameters listed in the order authentication proceeds.
detailPage.auth_flow_branch_intro: When entering GET /authorize?email=...: (1) redirect_uri must match the Callback URL, and (2) if a BioPass app device with push is registered for that email, the flow shows mobile notification confirmation HTML → app approval → callback; (3) if no device exists, an email code is sent and the user goes to the verify-email page. Without email/phone, the guide page (email entry) is shown.
detailPage.auth_flow_step_1_desc: Branches to mobile, email, or guide screens based on email/phone query params and registered devices
detailPage.auth_flow_step_1_mobile: Step 2 (mobile): App notification confirmation HTML — push sent automatically, waiting for approval
detailPage.auth_flow_step_auth_status: Step 2 (mobile polling): POST /api/web/auth-request-status — browser checks for approval completion
detailPage.auth_flow_param_request_email_redirect_u: redirect_uri (required): URL to redirect to after successful authentication.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_request_email_email: email (required): Email address to receive the verification code.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_verify_token_token: token (required): access_token. Body or Authorization: Bearer header.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_redirect_uri: redirect_uri (required): URL to redirect to after successful authentication. Must match the Callback URL registered for the application.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_response_type: response_type (required): Only "code" is supported (Authorization Code flow).
detailPage.auth_flow_param_scope: scope (optional): Requested scopes, comma-separated (e.g. email,phone). Must match the app's login identifier settings.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_state: state (optional): For CSRF and state validation. Returned as-is on callback.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_email: email (optional): User email. If present and a push device exists → mobile notification screen; if not → redirect to verify-email (code entry). If omitted, the guide page prompts for email.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_lang: lang (optional): Auth page language (ko | en). May not override the Accept-Language header.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_auth_status_request_id: request_id (required): Auth request ID created by /authorize.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_auth_status_redirect_uri: redirect_uri (required): Callback URL to redirect to with an authorization code after approval.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_auth_status_state: state (optional): state passed with the authorize request.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_resend_email: email (required): Email address to resend the code to.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_phone: phone (optional): User phone number when signing in with phone.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_phone_origin: phone_origin (optional): Phone number (used the same way as phone).
detailPage.auth_flow_param_request_id: request_id (required): Auth request ID created by /authorize.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_redirect_uri_verify: redirect_uri (required): URL to redirect to after verification.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_state_verify: state (optional): Client state, passed on callback.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_code_6: code (required): 6-digit verification code received by email.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_redirect_uri_state_note: redirect_uri, state: Used for the callback redirect.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_code_callback: code: One-time authorization code. Used to exchange for an access token via POST /token.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_code_token: code (required): Authorization code received on callback.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_client_secret: client_secret (required when not using PKCE): Client Secret.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_redirect_uri_token: redirect_uri (optional): If provided, must match the registered Callback URL.
detailPage.auth_flow_param_expires_in: expires_in: Access token lifetime in seconds.
detailPage.regenerate_description: The existing secret will be invalidated immediately.
detailPage.secret_important_desc: This secret is shown only once. Store it in a safe place.
detailPage.auth_settings_desc: Configure how users authenticate. Set login identifiers and auth request limits.
detailPage.login_identifier_tooltip: Choose which identifier types users can use to sign in.
detailPage.auth_request_expiry_tooltip: How long an auth request remains valid (seconds). After this time, the request expires.
detailPage.duplicate_request_limit_tooltip: Maximum number of concurrent auth requests a user can have. Set to 0 for no limit.
detailPage.not_found_desc: The requested application does not exist or has been deleted.
detailPage.regenerate_error: Could not retrieve the Client Secret.

menu.developer.quickStartIntro: Integrate BioPass OAuth login into your website in 3 steps. Call the REST API directly (no separate SDK required).
menu.developer.docsIntro: API guide for integrating website login.
menu.developer.step1Desc: Create an application and obtain a Client ID and Client Secret.
menu.developer.step1Hint: In the Applications menu, create a new application and register a Callback URL (backend callback endpoint, e.g. https://your-site.com/api/auth/callback). The authorize redirect_uri must match this URL exactly.
menu.developer.step2Title: 2. Select an app and confirm credentials
menu.developer.noSdkNeeded: BioPass provides a REST API. You can integrate with the sample code below without installing an npm SDK.
menu.developer.selectAppForSamples: Selecting an app fills Client ID and Callback URL into the code samples below.
menu.developer.secretServerOnly: Keep the Client Secret only in server environment variables. Never expose it in the browser (frontend).
menu.developer.testEmailPrompt: Enter the email address to sign in with
menu.developer.callbackRequired: Please register a Callback URL first.
menu.developer.tabFlowDesc: The browser navigates to your own backend /api/auth/login, and the backend calls BioPass authorize. After authentication, BioPass sends a code to your backend Callback URL, and the backend exchanges it via POST /api/web/token.
menu.developer.backendFirstFlowNote: Recommended flow: frontend → your backend (/api/auth/login) → BioPass. Keep client_id and client_secret only in server environment variables, and register the Callback URL as a backend endpoint (e.g. /api/auth/callback).
menu.developer.redirectFlowNote: redirect_uri must match the application Callback URL (backend callback) exactly. Registering a frontend page URL can expose the code in the browser.
menu.developer.callbackUrlNote: If the authorize redirect_uri differs from the Callback URL in app settings, the auth flow will not start. For testing, use the registered Callback URL as-is.
menu.developer.tabFrontendDesc: The login button redirects to your own backend /api/auth/login, not BioPass. Do not expose code or client_secret in the browser.
menu.developer.tabBackendDesc: The backend redirects to BioPass authorize, exchanges the authorization code for an access_token on callback, then creates a session.
menu.developer.verifyTokenDesc: After token exchange, optionally verify user info:
menu.developer.tabReferenceDesc: Key Web API endpoints. See Swagger UI for the full specification.
